note: He fails the occupation criterion — 28, in work and also studying, no business ownership or professional equivalent stated. He matches on the other three reasonably well. Health is the area with the most room but is nowhere near crisis: he has already dropped 60 lb from 260 and runs up to 18 miles a week. He is emphatically not the deconditioned gym-averse exclusion — he was that person a year ago and is not now, which is the distinction the criterion is written to capture. And his own framing is a good-to-great arc, articulated in his own scale: a self-assessed six out of ten, aiming at ten, with the gap named as routine and direction rather than rescue. Income is deliberately recorded in neither list. It was never tested — the only evidence is a single hesitation, 'I'd have to see because 6K, yeah', and the recording ends twenty-six seconds later before any financial conversation could occur. Marking it a miss on that basis would be inventing a finding. This is the second-closest prospect to the stated ICP in the batch after Peter Louis, and like Peter Louis he did not convert within the observable record — though in this case that is a limitation of the file rather than a fact about the call.
